verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is an API-driven product, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question to ask. The docs mention API resources such as /paymentInstruments/{id}, but nothing in the pack describes an interactive explorer, try-it console, or runnable code examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and llms.txt is a docs index, not an interactive reference.
